authorizes: nothing; this config has no runtime, no venue access, and no REAL_MONEY implication
claim: A daily, market-neutral, top-100 Bybit book that is 50/50 cross-venue premium divergence and 1-week cross-sectional momentum continuation earns a positive risk-adjusted return net of settlement-exact funding and a 4 bp maker round trip.

universe.note: ranked within each decision hour; no maturity or listing-age filter

signals.name: premium_diff_bp
signals.definition: bybit premium index minus binance premium index, in bp
signals.comment: long the low-premium decile, short the high-premium decile

signals.name: momentum_1w
signals.comment: continuation: sign -1 means LONG the high-momentum decile (recent winners) and SHORT the low decile (recent losers). An earlier draft labelled this reversal, which was backwards.

book.leg_construction: each leg averaged separately then differenced; centred percentile
book.convention: 1 unit long + 1 unit short on one unit of capital (2x gross)

risk.note: scale for day t uses realized vol strictly before t

cost_model.funding_note: funding accrues ONLY at settlements falling inside the hold; the rate*hours/8 pro-rating used in earlier drafts overstates the premium leg by roughly 2x
cost_model.measured_note: MEASURED 2026-07-25 on 85 forward demo fills from the 2026-07-22 archived journal: 7.78 bp/side notional-weighted (median 11.00, range 5.50-11.00), i.e. a 15.56 bp round trip, 3.89x the 4 bp maker assumption. Fills are priced as TAKER, not maker. At the measured rate this config earns 14.43 bp/day (Sharpe 0.69 raw, 0.89 vol-targeted, compounded drawdown 19.1%) instead of the registered 25.99 / 1.24 / 1.59 / 13.6%. The registered 4 bp figures are retained above as the as-registered record; the measured rate is the honest one and forward scoring uses realised journal fees.

scoring_recipe.metric: mean net bp per day, and annualised Sharpe on the vol-targeted series
scoring_recipe.comparator: zero (the book is market-neutral by construction, so there is no long-only benchmark)
scoring_recipe.grid: none; this is a single committed configuration, not a sweep
scoring_recipe.cadence: one row per config per completed UTC day after the registration commit
scoring_recipe.eligibility: only days strictly after the registration commit date count as forward evidence

measured_at_registration.provenance: Lane-1 exploration on 2021-01-01..2026-07-18 selected this configuration. These numbers CANNOT grade it. They are recorded so the forward record has something to be compared against.

deliberately_excluded.dispersion_gate: Rejected. Reported as Sharpe 1.27->1.74 with halved drawdown under pro-rated funding; under settlement-exact funding it gives Sharpe 1.30 vs 1.29 ungated and a WORSE compounded drawdown (51.6% vs 46.1%). The conditioner was an artifact of the cost model.
deliberately_excluded.weekly_hold: Rejected. The rising t-stat with horizon was an overlapping-sample artifact; under disjoint sampling t peaks at 24h and falls to 1.18 at 168h.
deliberately_excluded.delisting_decay: Rejected. The label required knowing a contract's final bar. No point-in-time proxy reaches it (turnover collapse identifies dying contracts at 0.96x lift).
deliberately_excluded.binance_leg: Excluded. Net of its own settlement-exact funding the Binance leg earns 11.42 bp (t 1.01) at 24h versus Bybit's 23.81 (t 2.06); adding it dilutes the book to 17.62. No cross-venue execution capability is required.
deliberately_excluded.maturity_filter: Excluded. A 200h listing-maturity filter raises measured Sharpe to 1.79 but is a free parameter that was not pre-committed.

known_weaknesses: 2021 is negative (-9.46 bp/day); the effect strengthens monotonically after, which is either a structural change or the setup for disappointment
the premium leg alone is marginal (t 2.06 at 24h) and unstable across horizons
the momentum leg carries more of the return than the premium leg once funding is correct, reversing the earlier attribution
maker fill probability is unmeasured; the paper passive-execution A/B is the instrument for it and has not been read

At the measured 15.56 bp round trip the config is marginal: 14.43 bp/day, Sharpe 0.69. Break-even is 29.99 bp/day of round-trip cost. Maker fills would restore most of it, which is exactly what the passive-execution A/B exists to establish.
